about.title: Your ideas. Our prints.
about.lead: FARHAT PRINT is a creative print-on-demand studio. We turn a photo, a phrase or a logo into something you can wear or gift.
about.p1: Everything on this site is designed in your browser. We do not upload your files to a server. When you are ready, you send the preview on WhatsApp and we print it.
about.p2: T-shirts, mugs (including magic mugs), tote bags, caps, hoodies and jackets — produced with care in Morocco.

contact.title: Let’s print something
contact.lead: WhatsApp is the fastest way to order or ask a question.

legal.privacyBody: This website runs entirely in your browser. Designs, uploads and your cart stay on your device (local storage and IndexedDB). We do not operate a server-side database or account system. If you contact us on WhatsApp, that conversation follows WhatsApp’s own privacy rules.
legal.termsBody: The customizer is provided as a preview tool. Colors on screen can differ slightly from the printed result. Orders placed via WhatsApp are confirmed with you before production. Placeholder prices may change; the WhatsApp confirmation is the price that applies.
